Paste your BattleTag to create your RXPGuides import string, then copy it and paste it in game. The string is built right here on this page — nothing is sent anywhere.

Runs 100% in your browser

  • Nothing is uploaded. Your BattleTag never leaves your device and is not saved.
  • No server, no tracking. All guide data is already inside this page; it makes zero network requests (blocked by its own security policy).
  • Works offline. Save this page and disconnect from the internet — it still works.

Include the # and numbers. You can paste directly from Battle.net.

Where to put this?
  1. In game, open the RXPGuides menu and choose Import guide.
  2. Click the text field, paste with Ctrl+V, then click Import.
